ns2:course.label: Human Resources in RST
ns2:course.description: Examines theoretical and technical principles of personnel managers in leisure service agencies; recruitment, training, selection, and evaluation of personnel with special emphasis on applied measurement concepts and legislation related to personnel administration in leisure services. Prerequisite: RST 410 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: RST 410 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MS : Rec, Sport, Tourism -UIUC or MS: Rec,Sport,Tourism -UCGC.
ns2:course.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $582.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
